play_full_description.current:
Fire Message is a professional tool to test and debug Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) via the HTTP v1 API. Manage multiple projects and send notifications securely without backend scripts.

Security:
Encrypted Storage: Service Account JSON credentials are encrypted.
Local Only: Keys are saved locally and never sent to third-party servers.

Key Features:
Multi-App Support: Switch between Dev, Staging, and Production projects.
Targeting: Send to Device Tokens, Topics, or Conditions.
HTTP v1 API: Full support for Service Account JSON authentication.
History & Logs: View sent messages and API responses.
Efficiency: Duplicate and resend payloads instantly.
Custom Payloads: Full control over Notification and Data JSON fields.

Subscription Details Fire Message offers a free trial to test all features. After the trial ends, a yearly subscription is required for continued access.

By using this app, you agree to the below:
Privacy Policy: https://stanimeros.com/privacy-policy

ios_promotional_text.current: Manage multiple projects and test push notifications with confidence. Securely import Service Account JSONs and target complex conditions using encrypted local storage.
